query:
-- Add unique functional index on normalized email + companyId
-- This prevents duplicate users with same email (case-insensitive, trimmed)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_normalized_email_company 
ON users (companyId, (LOWER(TRIM(email))));
